note: Practical priors about bowfishing are hypotheses until validated by independent historical, public-dataset, literature or model evidence (owner-collected field data is optional, never required); fit-for-purpose targets are pre-declared requirements, not achievements.
role: Species knowledge for bowfishing targets: identification, biology, distribution and per-lake presence, habitat preferences, spawning requirements, tolerances and evidence-graded rules
bowfishingPurpose: Which species live in a lake, and what each one generally needs and tolerates, decides which targets a trip can expect at all.

predicts.desc: Presence labels per lake with source confidence

mustNotPredict: a species rule that has no direct, fully read evidence
the current or forecast behavioural state of fish at a lake and time (Biological Brain owns it)

providesTo.why: species rules, response bands and tolerances applied to current conditions

fitForPurpose.metric: species rules validated against independent historical or public observations
species rules with direct, fully read evidence

priorityQuestions: Do dated historical and public records support the spawn temperature bands?
